scene endofsecondbeach1
: Guh. Bring back the sun. One day of summer weather isn’t enough. I want more.
lines.zh: : 呃。把太阳还回来。才一天的夏天天气根本不够。我要更多。

lines.en: Niki was gone when I woke up.
lines.zh: 我醒来的时候，Niki 已经走了。

lines.en: I imagine it was a side effect of regret or something along those lines.
lines.zh: 我想，那大概是后悔的副作用，或者类似的东西。

lines.en: I can’t imagine it’s very nice to wake up next to {i}me{/i} of all people- especially when I’ve hurt her as much as I have in the past.
lines.zh: 毕竟在那么多人里，醒来时躺在{i}我{/i}身边的感觉一定不会太好——尤其是我过去伤她伤得那么深。

lines.en: Nothing happened, in case you were wondering.
lines.zh: 免得你多想，什么都没发生。

lines.en: I obviously {i}tried{/i} to make things happen, but she wasn’t having any of it.
lines.zh: 我当然{i}试着{/i}让事情发生，可她一点都不买账。

lines.en: I guess she just wanted the company.
lines.zh: 我想她只是想要有人陪。

lines.en: She kept my t-shirt, though, which is a surprisingly ex-girlfriend thing to do.
lines.zh: 不过她把我的 T 恤留下了，这可是前女友才会干的事，还挺出人意料的。

lines.en: But I’m sure I’ll be seeing her again as it was one of my extra thick ones and I need it in order to survive the winter.
lines.zh: 不过我肯定会再见到她的，因为那是我最厚的几件之一，我得靠它熬过这个冬天。

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach2
: You’re sure you have everything, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你确定东西都带齐了吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I’m missing a shirt, but that much is out of my control.
lines.zh: : 我少了一件衬衫，不过那不是我能控制的。

lines.en: : I think I’m fine when it comes to everything else, though. I didn’t bring a lot.
lines.zh: : 其他东西我想都齐了。我本来就没带多少。

lines.en: : Would someone remind me again why we have to leave so early, though?
lines.zh: : 不过谁能再提醒我一下，我们为什么非得这么早走？

lines.en: : Because we have[school], of course.
lines.zh: : 因为我们还要上 [school]，当然。

lines.en: : Would someone also remind me why Touka is here?
lines.zh: : 那谁也能再提醒我一下，Touka 为什么在这儿吗？

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach3
: How rude.
lines.zh: : 好无礼。

lines.en: : But since you are so insistent on knowing-
lines.zh: : 不过既然你这么坚持想知道——

lines.en: : I asked one time.
lines.zh: : 我就问了一次。

lines.en: : {i}Since you are so insistent,{/i} it is because I am still waiting to be thanked for enabling this vacation.
lines.zh: : {i}既然你这么坚持{/i}，那是因为我还在等你为促成这次旅行而向我道谢。

lines.en: : You’re probably going to be waiting for a while, Touka. Sensei’s not very good at thanking people for the nice things they do for him.
lines.zh: : 你大概得等上一阵子了，Touka。Sensei 很不擅长为别人为他做的好事道谢。

lines.en: : Lies. Thank you, Touka. I appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 造谣。谢谢你，Touka。我很感激。

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach4
: Hey! I helped, too! Where’s my “Thanks, Ayane! I love you!?”
lines.zh: : 嘿！我也出力了！我的那句「谢谢你，Ayane！我爱你！」呢？

lines.en: : Somewhere else. I’ll give it to you later.
lines.zh: : 在别的地方。我晚点再给你。

lines.en: : Oh. Well...um...the pleasure has been all mine.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯……那个……这是我的荣幸。

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach5
: {i}And{/i} mine.
lines.zh: : {i}也是{/i}我的。

lines.en: : But yeah...mostly Touka’s, I guess. Even if we didn’t use half of the rooms we paid for.
lines.zh: : 不过嗯……我想主要还是 Touka 的功劳吧。尽管我们付了钱的房间有一半都没用上。

lines.en: : Now that you’re done praising the people that aren’t me, we should probably get going. You wouldn’t want to miss[school], would you?
lines.zh: : 既然你夸完那些不是我的人了，我们大概该走了。你不会想错过 [school] 吧？

lines.en: : Is that a real question? Of course I’d want to miss[school]. I hate[school].
lines.zh: : 这算什么问题？我当然想错过 [school]。我讨厌 [school]。

lines.en: : I have to...do stuff there.
lines.zh: : 我得在那儿……做事情。

lines.en: : Probably even more today than usual, too.
lines.zh: : 而且今天大概比平常还要多。

lines.en: : Yeah. Mondays suck.
lines.zh: : 是啊。星期一最讨厌了。

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach6
: Wait...did you not hear?
lines.zh: : 等等……你没听说吗？

lines.en: : Hear what? I’ve been awake for like twenty minutes and you four are the only girls I’ve seen.
lines.zh: : 听说什么？我才醒了大概二十分钟，而你们四个是我唯一见过的女生。

lines.en: : Miss Watabe...
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师……

lines.en: : Miss Watabe overdosed last night and had to be rushed to the hospital.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师昨晚服药过量，被紧急送去医院了。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Osako came bursting into our room asking for help in the middle of the night. I’m surprised you didn’t hear anything.
lines.zh: : Osako 半夜冲进我们房间求救。我真没想到你居然什么都没听见。

lines.en: : Is she okay?
lines.zh: : 她还好吗？

lines.en: : Touka was able to arrange an ambulance right away and she’s stable {i}now{/i}...but she’s going to be taking off of[school] for a little while so she can recover.
lines.zh: : Touka 立刻安排了救护车，她{i}现在{/i}情况稳定了……不过她要请一段时间假不去 [school]，好把身体养回来。

lines.en: : I’m sure you could have arranged for a transport just as quickly as me. I just happened to have a phone nearby.
lines.zh: : 我相信你也能和我一样快地安排好车辆。只是我碰巧手边有电话而已。

lines.en: : What was she on?
lines.zh: : 她吃的是什么？

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach7
: Does that really matter? Because it’s not something I really think any of us should be asking.
lines.zh: : 这真的有那么重要吗？因为我觉得，我们谁都不该问这种事。

lines.en: : No, it doesn’t matter I guess. I’m just a little confused.
lines.zh: : 不，我想是不重要。我只是有点糊涂。

lines.en: : It could have been an accident...
lines.zh: : 可能是意外吧……

lines.en: : I mean, it probably {i}was{/i} an accident.
lines.zh: : 我是说，大概{i}就是{/i}意外。

lines.en: : Miss Watabe is dark all the time, yeah. But...I don’t think she really means it when she says all that stuff about wanting to die.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师一直都很阴郁，没错。可是……我觉得她说那些想死的话，并不是真心的。

lines.en: : Perhaps we should make a “get well” card of some sort?
lines.zh: : 也许我们该做一张「早日康复」卡片什么的？

lines.en: : When I fell off my horse in elementary[school], my class got together and made a card like that for me.
lines.zh: : 我上小学 [school] 的时候从马上摔下来，全班就一起给我做了一张那样的卡片。

lines.en: : I thought it was very sweet.
lines.zh: : 我当时觉得非常暖心。

lines.en: : Until I found out that none of them wanted to sign it and that they only did it because the teachers asked them to and oh good now I’m feeling sad.
lines.zh: : 直到我发现他们没有一个人愿意在上面签名，他们这么做只是因为老师让他们做，哦太好了，现在我又难过了。

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach8
: Whatever happened...I think we should just leave the two of them alone for a little while and let them work through it.
lines.zh: : 不管发生了什么……我觉得我们应该先让她们两个单独待一阵子，让她们自己把事情理顺。

lines.en: : It’s not really our place to...get involved, I don’t think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，这真的不是我们该……插手的事。

lines.en: : But, umm...
lines.zh: : 不过，嗯……

lines.en: : On the bright side...Rin and Otoha are dating now?
lines.zh: : 往好处想……Rin 和 Otoha 现在交往了？

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot Rin was going to confess last night.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我都忘了 Rin 昨晚要表白。

lines.en: : Otoha really said yes?
lines.zh: : Otoha 真的答应了？

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach9
: Yes, but...how did you know Rin was going to confess?
lines.zh: : 答应了，不过……你怎么知道 Rin 要表白？

lines.en: : The same reason I know Touka sleeps on a vibrating love hotel bed. I’m popular.
lines.zh: : 跟我知道 Touka 睡在一张会震动的情侣酒店床上是一个原因。我很受欢迎。

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach10
: It...It is a normal, circular bed with rapid sleep technology!
lines.zh: : 那……那是一张普通的圆形床，配备了快速入睡科技！

lines.en: : Rapid what now?
lines.zh: : 快速什么？

lines.en: : And what does my bed have to do with those two forming a relationship with one another?!
lines.zh: : 还有，我的床跟那两个人交往有什么关系？！

lines.en: : Nothing, really. I just thought teasing you might cheer you up.
lines.zh: : 其实没什么关系。我只是觉得逗逗你也许能让你开心一点。

lines.en: : It-
scene endofsecondbeach11
: Wait...it actually kind of did.
lines.zh: : 等等……好像还真的有点用。

lines.en: : Huh.
: Either way! Looks like the harem is down two more girls and I am one step closer to...totally not marrying you because you’re my [uncle]! And that would be like, so weird, right?!
lines.zh: : 不管怎样！看来后宫又少了两个女生，而我又离……绝对不会嫁给你更近了一步，因为你是我 [uncle]！那会，怎么说呢，超级奇怪，对吧？！

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach12
: Unless...
lines.zh: : 除非……

lines.en: : Aaaaaanyway, I’m cold.
: And everybody else already went back to the dorms to shower and get ready for[school], so we might as well join them.
lines.zh: : 而且其他人都已经回宿舍洗澡、准备上 [school] 了，所以我们不如也跟上。

lines.en: : In the shower? Good plan. Let’s head out, team.
lines.zh: : 一起洗澡？好计划。出发吧，各位。

lines.en: scene black
As you may have guessed, I’m not able to shower with any of them.
lines.zh: 你大概猜到了，我没法和她们任何一个一起洗澡。

lines.en: But Touka is the only one who winds up heading back to the dorms anyway.
lines.zh: 不过最后也只有 Touka 一个人回了宿舍。

lines.en: Ayane and Maya return to the house with Ami and me because that’s where they left all of their stuff.
lines.zh: Ayane 和 Maya 跟着我和 Ami 回了家，因为她们的东西都留在那儿。

lines.en: And since they’re [teenage]girls and it isn’t weird for them to bathe together or whatever, they decide to just save time by {i}not{/i} adding an extra stop to the mix.
lines.zh: 而且既然她们是 [teenage] 女生，一起洗澡什么的也{i}不{/i}奇怪，她们决定干脆省下多跑一趟的时间。

lines.en: I’m sure they would have invited Touka as well if it weren’t for the fact that they’d have trouble fitting her breasts in the bath alongside them.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定她们本来也会叫上 Touka 的，如果不是因为很难把她的胸部和她们一起塞进浴缸的话。

lines.en: Sorry, Touka.
lines.zh: 抱歉了，Touka。

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach13
: Touka?...
lines.zh: : Touka？……

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : Where did everyone go?...
lines.zh: : 大家都去哪儿了？……

lines.en: scene black
scene endofsecondbeach14
The same room as always.
lines.zh: 还是那间老房间。

lines.en: I wonder how many times it’s been now. And how many more mornings I’ll get to watch the light creep through the blinds.
lines.zh: 我在想，到现在已经是多少次了。还有多少个早晨，我能看着光从百叶窗的缝隙里爬进来。

lines.en: I hope it really does last forever.
lines.zh: 我真的希望它能永远持续下去。

lines.en: Because even if this world isn't something I understand...or something Maya understands...
lines.zh: 因为哪怕这个世界不是我能理解的……也不是 Maya 能理解的……

lines.en: It’s my home now.
lines.zh: 它现在是我的家了。

lines.en: And sure, it can be pretty horrible at times with friends overdosing or having their hearts broken-
lines.zh: 当然，它有时候也挺可怕的，朋友服药过量，或者心碎——

lines.en: Actually, correction. Rin didn’t have her heart broken this time.
lines.zh: 等等，更正一下。这一次 Rin 的心并没有被伤到。

lines.en: Good for her.
lines.zh: 她真是太好了。

lines.en: I can only imagine how Molly must be feeling, though.
lines.zh: 不过我能想象 Molly 现在是什么感受。

lines.en: I’ll have to check on her-
lines.zh: 我得去看看她——

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach15
...soon.
lines.zh: ……很快。

lines.en: : Don’t speak.
lines.zh: : 别说话。

lines.en: : Just let me have this.
lines.zh: : 就让我拥有这一刻吧。

lines.en: : Please.
lines.zh: : 求你了。

lines.en: scene endofsecondbeach16
: Okay.
Remember the other morning when I told you that I’d find myself losing battle after battle soon enough?
lines.zh: 还记得那天早上我跟你说过，我很快就会一场接一场地打败仗吗？

lines.en: Well-
I managed to win one in the end.
lines.zh: 最后我总算赢了一场。

lines.en: scene black
Maya leaves the room silently, without asking me to forget about this or...abstain from bringing it up to anyone else.
lines.zh: Maya 无声地离开了房间，没有要我忘掉这件事，也没有……要我别对任何人提起。

lines.en: But I don’t think I will either way.
lines.zh: 不过不管怎样，我想我都不打算说。

lines.en: Just like I don’t think I’ll tell anyone about Niki showing up in my room last night to just...leave before sunrise without saying anything.
lines.zh: 就像我也不打算告诉任何人，Niki 昨晚出现在我房间里，然后只是……在日出前一声不吭地离开。

lines.en: I have no reason to tell anyone at all about either of these things.
lines.zh: 这两件事，我都没有任何理由告诉任何人。

lines.en: But it’s still only morning.
lines.zh: 可现在毕竟还只是早晨。

lines.en: And even if everything is bright and beautiful now, it doesn’t mean it will be later.
lines.zh: 而就算此刻一切都光明、都美好，也不代表之后还会如此。

lines.en: The person I trust least of all is myself.
lines.zh: 我最不信任的人，是我自己。

lines.en: I don’t deserve any of this.
lines.zh: 这一切，我都不配拥有。
